svg.title: Course booking in production
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 7 components and 9 connections in 5 boundaries. It shows the environment Production: 7 instances of 6 components of the model; only the connections listed for the instances are drawn. Cloud region: Job queue (jobs-prod), Bookings (db-prod), Certificates (files-prod), Container cluster. Container cluster (in Cloud region): Ingress (ingress-prod), Node A, Node B, Node pool: workers. Node A (in Container cluster): Booking API (api-1). Node B (in Container cluster): Booking API (api-2). Node pool: workers (in Container cluster): Worker (worker-1). Nothing leads into Ingress (ingress-prod). Nothing leads out of Bookings (db-prod) and Certificates (files-prod). Ingress (ingress-prod) (service): connects to Booking API (api-1) (routes, via HTTP) and Booking API (api-2) (routes, via HTTP). Booking API (api-1) (artifact): connects to Bookings (db-prod) (reads, writes, via SQL/TLS) and Job queue (jobs-prod) (queues jobs). Booking API (api-2) (artifact): connects to Bookings (db-prod) (reads, writes, via SQL/TLS) and Job queue (jobs-prod) (queues jobs). Job queue (jobs-prod) (queue): connects to Worker (worker-1) (delivers). Worker (worker-1) (artifact): connects to Certificates (files-prod) (stores certificates) and Bookings (db-prod) (updates, via SQL/TLS). Bookings (db-prod) (database): no outgoing connection. Certificates (files-prod) (storage): no outgoing connection.

polyline.title: Booking API (api-1) → Job queue (jobs-prod): queues jobs
Booking API (api-2) → Job queue (jobs-prod): queues jobs
